What exists is installLegacyPiSpecifierShim() at packages/coding-agent/src/extensibility/plugins/legacy-pi-compat.ts:2727, installed at extensions/loader.ts:59, whose onResolve filter is LEGACY_PI_SPECIFIER_FILTER at legacy-pi-compat.ts:837 — a generic legacy `@oh-my-pi/*` specifier shim, alongside a TypeBox shim at :873 and bundled virtual/host namespaces.
